_comment: The one description per project that every published surface uses: the profile README, the portfolio README, the site project cards, and the no-JavaScript fallback list. Each entry was checked against the repository's own package.json or pyproject.toml description. Keep the text free of ampersands and of markdown or HTML links; each surface adds its own links. verify-build.py fails if any surface drifts from this file.
Her--Him: Two complete AI-companion personality catalogues with a deterministic, explainable affect engine and mood-driven multilingual voice.
TRISHUL: Authorized-scope, AI-powered security testing platform with real tool integration behind scope gates and an AI policy boundary.
accessweave: Offline identity-relationship and directory-permission review from explicitly exported inventory data.
aegis: Multi-agent system core: task lifecycle, persistent memory, provider abstraction, default-deny tool registry, budgets and recovery.
agent-browser: Visible Playwright browser starter with an explicit domain allow-list and explicit stop conditions.
agent-skills: A 1200-skill agent skill library with a deterministic master router that selects the right skill for any task.
api-security-testing: Read-only BOLA and cross-tenant detector with a rate-limit probe, backed by a local mock API for reproducible demos.
catalog-forge: Crawls a shop catalog and serves it as a storefront.
cipherbench: A benchmark and interoperability test harness specification for vetted post-quantum cryptographic providers.
context-bridge: A VS Code extension that writes privacy-conscious Markdown handoffs, with secret redaction built in.
fixqueue: Merge SARIF, Trivy, Grype and OSV scanner output into one deduplicated, EPSS and KEV prioritized fix queue.
fuzzharbor: A reproducible local fuzzing campaign manager and crash triage toolkit.
gravion-ai: Gravion AI: a modular AI platform framework — many AI types, four tiers, one module system, with a cryptographic licensing and entitlement layer for commercial deployments.
gravion-harness: A scoped, auditable security-testing harness with a hash-chained audit log.
gravion-hunter: Autonomous bug bounty agent framework — scope-locked hunting, a hard 7-question validation gate, dedupe-in-the-loop, and a validity brake on autopilot submission.
gravion-trainner: Model quality evaluation starter for OpenAI-compatible chat-completions endpoints.
iamosiac: Offline cloud-IAM policy review and permission-relationship visualization data, with least-privilege remediation hints.
jwt-auditor: Defensive security auditor for JSON Web Tokens: alg=none, weak HMAC secrets, embedded keys, kid injection, lifetime and claim hygiene.
llm-redteam-kit: Authorized LLM red-teaming evaluation toolkit: OWASP LLM Top 10 probe packs, heuristic scoring, CI regression gates.
llm-security-bot: Pattern-based static analysis for code, configs, log lines and LLM input — deterministic, so the output is a triage list, not proof of exploitability.
local-slm-eval-kit: Evaluates a local model against a fixed task suite with redaction, timeouts and diffable reports.
localshare: Shares a local development server through Cloudflare tunnels, with loopback-only origins.
mcp-shield: Defensive security auditor for MCP server configurations and tool definitions.
memorytrust: Audits an agent memory store for unverified, stale, contradictory and sensitive content and scores how much can be trusted.
opsledger: Tamper-evident evidence ledger for red-team engagements: hash-chained events and a signed manifest.
preference-data-doctor: Diagnoses and repairs preference datasets: duplicates, contradictions, class imbalance, format drift, leaked secrets.
privacyflow: Validates authorized WireGuard profiles and plans safe VPN rotation workflows.
quanta-sentry: Cryptographic inventory and post-quantum migration-readiness reporting from source and configuration evidence.
rasgulla-ai: A local-first AI-assisted security research workbench for code understanding and safe test generation.
rulebench: Sigma rule conformance harness: run rules against events, lint them, and measure coverage against the MITRE knowledge base.
secret-sniper: Leaked credential detection with live verification.
security-automation-scripts: Small Node.js and Bash utilities: header analysis, TLS configuration check, log parsing helpers.
skill-supply-chain-auditor: Audits agent skill packages for prompt injection, unsafe shell, obfuscated payloads, embedded secrets, unpinned dependencies.
violet-trace: A safe purple-team validation harness for defensive telemetry and detection-rule tests.
web-security-labs: Four OWASP-style labs (IDOR, XSS, broken-auth, logic-flaw), each with a vulnerable and a secure variant, loopback-only by design.
webapp-security-toolkit: Authorized-only web and API security assessment toolkit: header analysis, TLS posture, scope enforcement, structured findings.
wp-cve-hunter: Match WordPress plugin and theme versions against known CVEs — a defensive, authorised-testing CLI for site owners and bug bounty researchers.
xerj-ipv6-rate-limit-fix: A contribution to xerj-org/xerj fixing the Corpus Hub rate limiter to bucket compressed IPv6 addresses by their /64. Merged upstream as xerj-org/xerj#2872 on 2026-11-17.
universal-hacker-kit: A Claude Code command kit for bug bounty hunting: write, triage, gotchas and dedupe commands for drafting and validating reports before submission (free edition).
apishield: Zero-dependency API security gateway: a monitor and enforce reverse proxy that catches BOLA/IDOR ownership flaws, JWT weaknesses and response data exposure before they ship.
vulndesk: Multi-tenant vulnerability-management and triage platform: tenant-isolated workspaces, RBAC, a real CVSS 3.1 scoring engine, hash-based dedupe and exportable reports.
taskforge: TaskForge — full-stack team task manager (MERN): JWT auth, role-based access, projects, kanban boards with drag-and-drop, tasks, comments.
chatsphere: ChatSphere — real-time chat app (direct and group) with Socket.io and MongoDB: JWT-authenticated sockets, presence, typing indicators, unread counts; React frontend.
expensemate: ExpenseMate — React Native (Expo) expense tracker in TypeScript: categories, monthly summaries, breakdown charts, AsyncStorage persistence, multi-currency, dark theme.
security-research: Responsible-disclosure write-ups from my WordPress plugin security research — concept-level, sanitised, no exploit payloads.
gravion-hacker: Offline-first authorized security assessment suite: scope-gated, read-only checks over headers, cookies, CORS policy, TLS and DNS snapshots, JWT structure, dependency manifests and local source, with a CLI, a web UI and report-ready evidence.
pe-import-lens: Dependency-free Windows PE import-table triage: lists every imported function and flags the imports tied to process injection, process hollowing, keylogging and anti-analysis checks. The target file is only parsed, never executed.
winapi-sentinel: Static source-code triage for risky Windows API usage patterns, flagging single sensitive calls and multi-call injection chains with file and line evidence for every finding.
gravion-pets: AI pet companion framework — 46 original pets across 10 categories (gods and devils included), personalities, moods, bonds and an actions and movements system.
cookie-audit: Pure Python cookie security analyzer: audits Set-Cookie headers for missing or weak security attributes, taking input from a file, a URL or standard input, with text or JSON reports and a severity threshold for CI.
gravion-bot: Terminal-first bot project with a separate web command deck: a TypeScript API server for bot sessions, commands and files, plus a small Python web shell that exposes help, status and pet commands in the browser.
openapi-diff: OpenAPI 3.x breaking-change differ with CI-friendly exit codes: resolves local references so schemas are compared by effective shape, then classifies every change as breaking, non-breaking or informational with a location and a reason.
sri-guard: Subresource Integrity checker for HTML pages: finds external scripts and stylesheets whose integrity metadata is missing, malformed or does not match the served content, and reports the missing crossorigin attribute that stops the browser enforcing it.
subdangler: Dangling DNS and subdomain takeover risk checker: resolves CNAME records over DNS-over-HTTPS, matches them against takeover-prone services and reports the ones that look unclaimed. Authorised use only.
vocals: Browser voice and song studio: record or clone a voice, generate a procedural beat and mix and master a WAV export, with an optional bring-your-own AI voice endpoint that keeps the key in the browser.
ai-model-fingerprint: Defensive checker for AI model files: detects the container format, computes SHA-256 fingerprints, lists the URLs embedded in the file header and verifies model files against a hash manifest. It never executes model code.
memsafety-lab: Educational memory-safety lab: scans C source for the unsafe functions behind classic buffer overflows and prints the safe replacement for every hit as a fix checklist.
osint-footprint-checker: Scores the public footprint of an asset you own from a JSON snapshot: security.txt, security headers, SPF and DMARC, dangling CNAMEs and TLS posture, with the fix for every finding. Offline and snapshot-based.
winapi-surface-auditor: Defensive code review for C and C++ source: scans Windows API usage patterns tied to cross-process injection, input interception and legacy process creation, and explains the safer alternative for each hit. It ships no exploit code.
